post_wise_qualification.post_name: Assistant Professor (Law, Legal and Constitutional History)
post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: M.A. in History or LL.M. specialisation in Legal History with 55% (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University or Ph.D. in Constitutional History.

MBA in Strategic Management with experience of teaching Game Theory or M.A. Economics with experience of teaching Game Theory with 55% (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University or Ph.D. in Game Theory.

qualification.details: The UGC-prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum, and possessing them does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Higher qualifications will be given preference. Degrees from reputed foreign Universities and from IIMs and National Law Universities would be preferred. Preference will also go to applicants with experience of teaching in National Law Universities. The applicant must be a citizen of India. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the CNLU website at the recruitment notice page.
Fill in the application form completely, because applications incomplete in any respect will not be considered at all.
Upload the filled-in scanned application form through the Google Form link given in the notice, latest by 21 November 2026.
Watch your email: the University will make all correspondence only through email, and short-listed applicants will be intimated only through email.
For clarifications, the University can be contacted at [email protected].
important_instructions: The University may constitute a Screening Committee to scrutinise the applications and short-list applicants. It may also restrict the number of applicants called for interview, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum or any other condition it deems fit. The call letter for interview will be sent only to short-listed applicants. No correspondence will be entertained with applicants who are not short-listed. On-line interviews are likely to be held. In case of physical interviews, no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification for the post. In case of any disputes, suits or legal proceedings against the University, the jurisdiction shall be restricted to the High Court of Judicature at Patna.

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Chanakya National Law University is located at Nyaya Nagar, Mithapur, Patna 800001 (Bihar). The notice describes it as a university established by Act No. XXIV of 2006 and a premier institution of legal education.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 vacancies in total. It prints no category-wise break-up. The University reserves the right to increase the positions, to fill all or some of the advertised positions, or not to fill any. The reservation roster prescribed by the Government of Bihar will be followed.

rows.experience: Experience of teaching Game Theory, as part of the MBA and M.A. Economics options above

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both posts are on contractual basis. The notice prints no pay for either post. On the Selection Committee's recommendation, the University may offer a lower post such as Research Associate, Teacher Associate or Lecturer to an applicant who applied for a higher post, depending on the applicant's performance before the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CNLU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the CNLU website at the recruitment notice page. Fill in the application form completely, because applications incomplete in any respect will not be considered at all. Upload the filled-in scanned application form through the Google Form link given in the notice, latest by 21 November 2026. Watch your email: the University will make all correspondence only through email, and short-listed applicants will be intimated only through email. For clarifications, the University can be contacted at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled-in scanned application form, uploaded through the Google Form. Original documents, to be produced at the time of interview.

content_sections.text: The University may constitute a Screening Committee to scrutinise the applications and short-list applicants. It may also restrict the number of applicants called for interview, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum or any other condition it deems fit. The call letter for interview will be sent only to short-listed applicants. No correspondence will be entertained with applicants who are not short-listed. On-line interviews are likely to be held. In case of physical interviews, no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification for the post. In case of any disputes, suits or legal proceedings against the University, the jurisdiction shall be restricted to the High Court of Judicature at Patna.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CNLU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Assistant Professor (Law, Legal and Constitutional History) and one Assistant Professor (Management).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CNLU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026, by which the filled-in scanned application form must be uploaded through the Google Form.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor (Management) at CNLU?
faq.answer: MBA in Strategic Management with experience of teaching Game Theory, or M.A. Economics with experience of teaching Game Theory, with 55% from an Indian University. An equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University or a Ph.D. in Game Theory is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor (Law, Legal and Constitutional History)?
faq.answer: M.A. in History or LL.M. specialisation in Legal History with 55% from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University, or a Ph.D. in Constitutional History.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for CNLU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from the CNLU website, fill it in, and upload the scanned copy through the Google Form link given in the notice by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Are the CNLU Assistant Professor posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice invites applications for these teaching positions on contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. How will CNLU select candidates?
faq.answer: The University may use a Screening Committee to short-list applicants, who are then called for interview. A Selection Committee makes the recommendation.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the CNLU interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid in case of physical interviews. On-line interviews are likely to be held.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to carry original documents to the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants shall have to produce original documents at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can a foreign national apply for CNLU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: No. The applicant must be a citizen of India.
